mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and may increase acetaminophen metabolism via CYP2E1, potentially increasing hepatotoxic metabolite (NAPQI) formation, particularly at higher acetaminophen doses.
action: Monitor for signs of hepatotoxicity; avoid high-dose acetaminophen (>3g/day) during erythromycin therapy; consider alternative antipyretic if prolonged use anticipated.
